issue_title: Homepage performance persistently below 85 — LCP stuck above 6.6 s for 4+ consecutive audits
issue_body:
# Homepage Performance Regression — Persistent LCP > 6 s

**Audited:** 2026-07-30T10:35:04.258Z
**Status:** Warnings (4th+ consecutive audit below threshold)

## Problem
The homepage (`/`) has failed to reach a Lighthouse performance score of 85 for at least four consecutive nightly audits. The LCP has been above 6.5 s each time, indicating no structural fix has been applied.

| Audit date | Perf | LCP |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-07-27 (est.) | ~69 | ~6.46 s |
| 2026-07-28 (est.) | ~69 | ~6.46 s |
| 2026-07-29 | 70 | 6.57 s |
| **2026-07-30** | **73** | **6.70 s** |

## Root cause (likely)
- Hero image is not preloaded and is not served in a next-gen format (WebP/AVIF)
- Render-blocking resources above the fold delaying paint
- Image dimensions not sized for mobile viewport

## Recommended fix
1. Add `<link rel="preload" as="image" href="[hero-image]">` in `<head>`
2. Convert the hero image to WebP/AVIF and serve at appropriately sized srcset breakpoints
3. Defer or async any render-blocking JS/CSS not needed for the initial paint
4. Verify with a local Lighthouse run targeting mobile

**Expected outcome:** 15–20+ point performance improvement, LCP below 3 s.

## Secondary issue
`/about` remains a blank placeholder ("This is an about page") with no nav, content, or footer — SEO score 83 (below 85 threshold). This page is actively linked from the main nav and reflects poorly on the portfolio.
